	table _Measures
		lineageTag: 3393efa3-e3e5-51d4-ae7a-a1e6c00c497a

		measure 'Total Shipments' = SUM ( Fact_VolumeSpend[Volume] )
			formatString: #,0
			displayFolder: 1 Volume, Spend and Cost\Shipment volume
			lineageTag: 9ee6c617-c6d2-56db-b2fe-9c3a1c34c551

		measure 'Rankable Shipments' =
				
				CALCULATE (
				    [Total Shipments],
				    KEEPFILTERS ( Fact_VolumeSpend[IncludeInRanking] = "Yes" ),
				    KEEPFILTERS ( Fact_VolumeSpend[HasVolume] = "Yes" )
				)
			formatString: #,0
			displayFolder: 1 Volume, Spend and Cost\Shipment volume
			lineageTag: 4cca2c13-58a0-5434-8ee6-f3693de3598c

		measure 'YTD Shipments' =
				
				VAR CurrentYear = MAX ( Dim_Date[Year] )
				VAR CurrentMonth = MAX ( Dim_Date[MonthNumber] )
				RETURN
				    CALCULATE (
				        [Total Shipments],
				        REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Date ),
				        Dim_Date[Year] = CurrentYear,
				        Dim_Date[MonthNumber] <= CurrentMonth
				    )
			formatString: #,0
			displayFolder: 1 Volume, Spend and Cost\Shipment volume
			lineageTag: 382275f9-36ad-5be9-bf5a-6c58166b73c7

		measure 'Shipments PY' =
				
				VAR PriorKeys =
				    SELECTCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( Dim_Date[MonthKey] ), "@Key", Dim_Date[MonthKey] - 100 )
				RETURN
				    CALCULATE (
				        [Total Shipments],
				        REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Date ),
				        TREATAS ( PriorKeys, Dim_Date[MonthKey] )
				    )
			formatString: #,0
			displayFolder: 1 Volume, Spend and Cost\Shipment volume
			lineageTag: 9ad8c10d-bc5d-5881-89ba-4d7a6e0ab3ad

		measure 'Shipments YoY %' =
				
				VAR Current = [Total Shipments]
				VAR Prior = [Shipments PY]
				RETURN
				    DIVIDE ( Current - Prior, Prior )
			formatString: 0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%
			displayFolder: 1 Volume, Spend and Cost\Shipment volume
			lineageTag: e78a95d3-4136-5c2e-b0c4-265e23ef0a44

		measure 'Avg Net Spend per Billed Lb' =
				
				DIVIDE (
				    CALCULATE (
				        [Total Net Spend],
				        KEEPFILTERS ( Fact_VolumeSpend[IncludeInRanking] = "Yes" ),

			formatString: \$#,0.000
			displayFolder: 1 Volume, Spend and Cost\Cost efficiency
			lineageTag: 8a57d846-0bc2-526b-b381-007a164dc3f2

		measure 'Weight-Adjusted Cost Premium' =
				
				VAR BlendedRatePerLb =
				    CALCULATE (
				        [Avg Net Spend per Billed Lb],
				        REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service ),
				        VALUES ( Dim_Date[MonthKey] )
				    )
				VAR ExpectedSpend = [Total Billed Weight] * BlendedRatePerLb
				RETURN
				    DIVIDE ( [Total Net Spend] - ExpectedSpend, ExpectedSpend )
			formatString: 0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%
			displayFolder: 1 Volume, Spend and Cost\Mix
			lineageTag: b1c1c383-1efc-5957-bee7-980ff627d68d

		measure 'OTD % PM' =
				
				VAR CurrentKey = SELECTEDVALUE ( Dim_Date[MonthKey] )
				VAR PriorKey =
				    IF ( MOD ( CurrentKey, 100 ) = 1, CurrentKey - 89, CurrentKey - 1 )
				RETURN
				    IF (
				        NOT ISBLANK ( CurrentKey ),
				        CALCULATE (
				            [On-Time Delivery %],
				            REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Date ),
				            Dim_Date[MonthKey] = PriorKey
				        )
				    )
			formatString: 0.00%;-0.00%;0.00%
			displayFolder: 2 Reliability\Trend and stability
			lineageTag: c548de76-2123-5155-999d-437910daa3ee

		measure 'OTD % Delta MoM' =
				
				VAR Current = [On-Time Delivery %]
				VAR Prior = [OTD % PM]
				RETURN
				    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( Current ) && NOT ISBLANK ( Prior ), Current - Prior )
			formatString: 0.00%;-0.00%;0.00%
			displayFolder: 2 Reliability\Trend and stability
			lineageTag: 560c110a-30c1-5964-9caa-06af64da7d8e

		measure 'OTD % Annual Benchmark' =
				
				CALCULATE (
				    [On-Time Delivery %],
				    REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Date[MonthNumber], Dim_Date[MonthName], Dim_Date[Quarter],
				        Dim_Date[MonthYearLabel], Dim_Date[MonthKey] )
				)
			formatString: 0.00%;-0.00%;0.00%
			displayFolder: 2 Reliability\Trend and stability
			lineageTag: b8c686f3-70c5-5248-9f6c-6da175d05692

		measure 'OTD Volatility (pp)' =
				
				VAR MonthlySeries =
				    ADDCOLUMNS (
				        CALCULATETABLE (
				            VALUES ( Dim_Date[MonthKey] ),
				            Dim_Date[IsReportable] = "Yes"
				        ),
				        "@OTD", [On-Time Delivery %]
				    )
				VAR Clean = FILTER ( MonthlySeries, NOT ISBLANK ( [@OTD] ) )
				RETURN
				    IF ( COUNTROWS ( Clean ) >= 2, STDEVX.P ( Clean, [@OTD] ) * 100 )
			formatString: #,0.00
			displayFolder: 2 Reliability\Trend and stability
			lineageTag: c4247a76-f99f-5264-8397-49eb7c160ee2

		measure 'Worst OTD Month' =
				
				VAR MonthlySeries =
				    ADDCOLUMNS (
				        CALCULATETABLE (
				            VALUES ( Dim_Date[MonthYearLabel] ),
				            Dim_Date[IsReportable] = "Yes"
				        ),
				        "@OTD", [On-Time Delivery %]
				    )
				VAR Clean = FILTER ( MonthlySeries, NOT ISBLANK ( [@OTD] ) )
				RETURN
				    IF (
				        NOT ISEMPTY ( Clean ),
				        CONCATENATEX (
				            TOPN ( 1, Clean, [@OTD], ASC ),
				            Dim_Date[MonthYearLabel] & " (" & FORMAT ( [@OTD], "0.0%" ) & ")"
				        )
				    )
			displayFolder: 2 Reliability\Statistical confidence
			lineageTag: ec9cab1c-4d2b-5d3e-b9d1-09c265a9bad2

		measure 'OTD Wilson Lower Bound' =
				
				VAR N = [Packages Measured]
				VAR Successes = [On-Time Packages]
				VAR Z = 1.96                                  // 95% two-sided
				VAR P = DIVIDE ( Successes, N )
				VAR Denominator = 1 + DIVIDE ( Z * Z, N )
				VAR Centre = P + DIVIDE ( Z * Z, 2 * N )
				VAR Margin =
				    Z * SQRT ( DIVIDE ( P * ( 1 - P ), N ) + DIVIDE ( Z * Z, 4 * N * N ) )
				RETURN
				    IF ( N > 0, DIVIDE ( Centre - Margin, Denominator ) )
			formatString: 0.00%;-0.00%;0.00%
			displayFolder: 2 Reliability\Statistical confidence
			lineageTag: 6f5d05dc-cb1e-50b7-968d-8da00be6ce32

		measure 'OTD Confidence Gap (pp)' =
				
				VAR Gap = [On-Time Delivery %] - [OTD Wilson Lower Bound]
				RETURN
				    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( Gap ), Gap * 100 )
			formatString: #,0.00
			displayFolder: 2 Reliability\Statistical confidence
			lineageTag: e41d2933-0c38-5749-8634-4432112b936e

		measure 'OTD Confidence Label' =
				
				VAR Gap = [OTD Confidence Gap (pp)]
				RETURN
				    SWITCH (
				        TRUE (),
				        ISBLANK ( Gap ), "No transit data",
				        Gap <= 0.5, "High confidence",
				        Gap <= 2.0, "Moderate confidence",
				        Gap <= 10.0, "Low confidence - small sample",
				        "Not interpretable - sample too small"
				    )
			displayFolder: 2 Reliability\Coverage
			lineageTag: 2b53a1bc-9396-5bbe-b6bf-887e7cdc11c4

				)
			formatString: 0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%
			displayFolder: 2 Reliability\Coverage
			lineageTag: d3496311-4476-5b25-841d-caaae5b8ff77

		measure 'Has Transit Data' = IF ( [Packages Measured] > 0, "Yes", "No" )

		measure 'Loss Risk Flag' =
				
				VAR Idx = [Loss Rate Index vs Firm]
				VAR Vol = [Rankable Shipments]
				RETURN
				    SWITCH (
				        TRUE (),
				        ISBLANK ( [Loss Claims] ) || [Loss Claims] = 0, "No loss activity",
				        Vol < 500, "Insufficient volume to rate",
				        Idx >= 3, "Critical - investigate",
				        Idx >= 2, "Elevated - monitor",
				        Idx >= 1, "Above firm average",
				        "At or below firm average"
				    )
			displayFolder: 3 Claims and Loss Risk\Concentration
			lineageTag: 1264bb43-643c-5969-9092-b6578a8a8a51

		measure 'Top Account Share of Loss Claims' =
				
				VAR ByAccount =
				    ADDCOLUMNS (
				        CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( Dim_Account[AccountKey] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Account ) ),
				        "@Loss", [Loss Claims]
				    )
				VAR TotalLoss = SUMX ( ByAccount, [@Loss] )
				VAR TopLoss = MAXX ( ByAccount, [@Loss] )
				RETURN
				    DIVIDE ( TopLoss, TotalLoss )
			formatString: 0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%
			displayFolder: 3 Claims and Loss Risk\Concentration
			lineageTag: b874cac7-b86d-565e-bb60-a3ae481a29c5

		measure 'Top Account by Loss Claims' =
				
				VAR ByAccount =
				    ADDCOLUMNS (
				        CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( Dim_Account[AccountName] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Account ) ),
				        "@Loss", [Loss Claims]
				    )
				RETURN
				    CONCATENATEX ( TOPN ( 1, ByAccount, [@Loss], DESC ), Dim_Account[AccountName] )
			displayFolder: 3 Claims and Loss Risk\Tier C: allocated service proxy - handle with care
			lineageTag: 8ea4314d-5ffc-5d8a-9ac3-fd04635eadbd

		measure 'Loss Claims (Allocated Proxy)' =
				
				SUMX (
				    VALUES ( Dim_Account[AccountKey] ),
				    VAR AccountLoss = CALCULATE ( [Loss Claims], REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service ) )
				    VAR AccountVolumeAllServices =
				        CALCULATE ( [Rankable Shipments], REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service ) )
				    VAR VolumeInScope = [Rankable Shipments]
				    RETURN
				        AccountLoss * DIVIDE ( VolumeInScope, AccountVolumeAllServices )
				)
			formatString: #,0.0
			displayFolder: 3 Claims and Loss Risk\Tier C: allocated service proxy - handle with care
			lineageTag: ffcd1448-72dc-57a8-b1b7-e6372778649d

		measure 'Loss Claim Rate per 10k (Allocated Proxy)' =
				
				DIVIDE ( [Loss Claims (Allocated Proxy)], [Rankable Shipments] ) * 10000
			formatString: #,0.00
			displayFolder: 3 Claims and Loss Risk\Tier C: allocated service proxy - handle with care
			lineageTag: 73f2b0b1-7fab-5419-92f6-4c81d5c7182d

		measure 'Claims Attribution Warning' =
				
				"Allocated estimate. The claims extract carries no service or tracking key; "
				    & "account-level claims are distributed across services by shipment volume. "
				    & "Not a measured service-level loss rate. Do not use for service selection."
			displayFolder: 3 Claims and Loss Risk\Tier C: allocated service proxy - handle with care
			lineageTag: 017d3b78-6f60-5e74-9fc7-729fd3c6d0ce

		measure 'Minimum Shipment Threshold' = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Volume Threshold'[Volume Threshold], 1000 )
			formatString: #,0
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\1. Qualification
			lineageTag: 4f827bc4-10f8-54fb-b45b-0e2d70fb4c73

		measure 'Minimum Volume Share' = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Share Threshold'[Share Threshold], 0.01 )
			formatString: 0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\1. Qualification
			lineageTag: 332cca93-15be-598a-a214-6162c4881f38

		measure 'Minimum Measured Packages' = 384
			formatString: #,0
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\1. Qualification
			lineageTag: 1c0ec210-b833-59e1-abcd-70d209c04136

		measure 'Service Volume Share' =
				
				DIVIDE (
				    [Rankable Shipments],
				    CALCULATE ( [Rankable Shipments], REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service ) )
				)
			formatString: 0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\1. Qualification
			lineageTag: b2e9bac8-c180-5fdb-9a8d-ce10b0fd1635

		measure 'Annual Qualification Flag' =
				
				VAR MeetsAbsolute = [Rankable Shipments] >= [Minimum Shipment Threshold]
				VAR MeetsShare = [Service Volume Share] >= [Minimum Volume Share]
				VAR MeetsMeasurement = [Packages Measured] >= [Minimum Measured Packages]
				
				
				
				VAR IsRankableService = SELECTEDVALUE ( Dim_Service[IncludeInRanking] ) = "Yes"
				RETURN
				    IF ( MeetsAbsolute && MeetsShare && MeetsMeasurement && IsRankableService, 1, 0 )
			formatString: #,0
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\1. Qualification
			lineageTag: aed5f62a-3ebc-581a-8c72-98ea473f0b1a

		measure 'Qualification Status' =
				
				VAR Vol = [Rankable Shipments]
				VAR Measured = [Packages Measured]
				RETURN
				    SWITCH (
				        TRUE (),
				        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1, "Qualified",
				        ISBLANK ( Vol ) || Vol = 0, "No shipment volume",
				        Measured < [Minimum Measured Packages],
				            "Transit sample too small (" & FORMAT ( Measured, "#,0" ) & " measured, "
				                & FORMAT ( [Minimum Measured Packages], "#,0" ) & " required)",
				        Vol < [Minimum Shipment Threshold],
				            "Below volume floor (" & FORMAT ( Vol, "#,0" ) & " of "
				                & FORMAT ( [Minimum Shipment Threshold], "#,0" ) & ")",
				        [Service Volume Share] < [Minimum Volume Share],
				            "Below " & FORMAT ( [Minimum Volume Share], "0.0%" ) & " volume share",
				        "Excluded from ranking by service mapping"
				    )
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\1. Qualification
			lineageTag: a01d7726-fe53-53c8-8575-8c336aeef00d

		measure 'Qualified Service Count' =
				
				COUNTROWS (
				    FILTER (
				        CALCULATETABLE (
				            VALUES ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
				            REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service )
				        ),
				        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
				    )
				)
			formatString: #,0
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\1. Qualification
			lineageTag: e62a3c61-fc29-5ef7-b8f9-8c318a5b5202

		measure 'Claims Service Key Available' = 0
			formatString: #,0
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\2. Normalised component scores
			lineageTag: a34c1687-c1a3-5d3d-af91-18d6b03d98e8

		measure 'Score - Reliability' =
				
				VAR QualifiedSet =
				    FILTER (
				        CALCULATETABLE (
				            VALUES ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
				            REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service )
				        ),
				        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
				    )
				VAR WithMetric = ADDCOLUMNS ( QualifiedSet, "@M", [OTD Wilson Lower Bound] )
				VAR Populated = FILTER ( WithMetric, NOT ISBLANK ( [@M] ) )
				VAR MinV = MINX ( Populated, [@M] )
				VAR MaxV = MAXX ( Populated, [@M] )
				VAR Self = [OTD Wilson Lower Bound]
				RETURN
				    IF (
				        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1 && NOT ISBLANK ( Self ),
				        IF ( MaxV = MinV, 1, DIVIDE ( Self - MinV, MaxV - MinV ) )
				    )
			formatString: #,0.00
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\2. Normalised component scores
			lineageTag: cb02405a-df05-57fb-bf31-a17d2c2bab60

		measure 'Score - Loss Risk' =
				
				VAR QualifiedSet =
				    FILTER (
				        CALCULATETABLE (
				            VALUES ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
				            REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service )
				        ),
				        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
				    )
				VAR WithMetric = ADDCOLUMNS ( QualifiedSet, "@M", [Loss Claim Rate per 10k] )
				VAR Populated = FILTER ( WithMetric, NOT ISBLANK ( [@M] ) )
				VAR MinV = MINX ( Populated, [@M] )
				VAR MaxV = MAXX ( Populated, [@M] )
				VAR Self = [Loss Claim Rate per 10k]
				RETURN
				    IF (
				        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1 && NOT ISBLANK ( Self ) && [Claims Service Key Available] = 1,
				        IF ( MaxV = MinV, 1, 1 - DIVIDE ( Self - MinV, MaxV - MinV ) )
				    )
			formatString: #,0.00
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\2. Normalised component scores
			lineageTag: 27d5388f-911b-51ef-831f-df2ff41eb193

		measure 'Score - Exception Risk' =
				
				VAR QualifiedSet =
				    FILTER (
				        CALCULATETABLE (
				            VALUES ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
				            REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service )
				        ),
				        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
				    )
				VAR WithMetric = ADDCOLUMNS ( QualifiedSet, "@M", [Claims Rate per 10k] )
				VAR Populated = FILTER ( WithMetric, NOT ISBLANK ( [@M] ) )
				VAR MinV = MINX ( Populated, [@M] )
				VAR MaxV = MAXX ( Populated, [@M] )
				VAR Self = [Claims Rate per 10k]
				RETURN
				    IF (
				        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1 && NOT ISBLANK ( Self ) && [Claims Service Key Available] = 1,
				        IF ( MaxV = MinV, 1, 1 - DIVIDE ( Self - MinV, MaxV - MinV ) )
				    )
			formatString: #,0.00
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\2. Normalised component scores
			lineageTag: f5dd1b52-aaad-5047-b913-420cdb0e3fea

		measure 'Score - Cost' =
				
				VAR QualifiedSet =
				    FILTER (
				        CALCULATETABLE (
				            VALUES ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
				            REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service )
				        ),
				        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
				    )
				VAR WithMetric = ADDCOLUMNS ( QualifiedSet, "@M", [Avg Net Spend per Billed Lb] )
				VAR Populated = FILTER ( WithMetric, NOT ISBLANK ( [@M] ) )
				VAR MinV = MINX ( Populated, [@M] )
				VAR MaxV = MAXX ( Populated, [@M] )
				VAR Self = [Avg Net Spend per Billed Lb]
				RETURN
				    IF (
				        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1 && NOT ISBLANK ( Self ),
				        IF ( MaxV = MinV, 1, 1 - DIVIDE ( Self - MinV, MaxV - MinV ) )
				    )
			formatString: #,0.00
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\3. Weighted blend with reallocation
			lineageTag: 469e4445-bd69-56b0-9835-fb913324bb0f

		measure 'Weight - Reliability' = 0.40
			formatString: 0%;-0%;0%
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\3. Weighted blend with reallocation
			lineageTag: cf045b93-7c98-5ad8-90cd-6fbb38f022f7

		measure 'Weight - Loss Risk' = 0.30
			formatString: 0%;-0%;0%
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\3. Weighted blend with reallocation
			lineageTag: aa2f0729-2870-582a-b56d-527e7b6e1514

		measure 'Weight - Exception Risk' = 0.20
			formatString: 0%;-0%;0%
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\3. Weighted blend with reallocation
			lineageTag: ad97f364-a7bd-5909-99a9-0362ab8ea597

		measure 'Weight - Cost' = 0.10
			formatString: 0%;-0%;0%
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\3. Weighted blend with reallocation
			lineageTag: 6589c4f8-5024-57d4-be9a-d5d9056df3bb

		measure 'Effective Weight Total' =
				
				VAR W =
				    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Reliability] ), [Weight - Reliability], 0 )
				        + IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Loss Risk] ), [Weight - Loss Risk], 0 )
				        + IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Exception Risk] ), [Weight - Exception Risk], 0 )
				        + IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Cost] ), [Weight - Cost], 0 )
				RETURN
				    IF ( W > 0, W )
			formatString: #,0.00
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\3. Weighted blend with reallocation
			lineageTag: 4cc03ab0-4670-546c-8bfb-b7b2ebe7029d

		measure 'Service Consistency Score' =
				
				VAR Weighted =
				    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Reliability] ), [Score - Reliability] * [Weight - Reliability], 0 )
				        + IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Loss Risk] ), [Score - Loss Risk] * [Weight - Loss Risk], 0 )
				        + IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Exception Risk] ), [Score - Exception Risk] * [Weight - Exception Risk], 0 )
				        + IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Cost] ), [Score - Cost] * [Weight - Cost], 0 )
				RETURN
				    IF (
				        [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1,
				        DIVIDE ( Weighted, [Effective Weight Total] ) * 100
				    )
			formatString: #,0.0
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\3. Weighted blend with reallocation
			lineageTag: 6e7c86f2-7df2-5232-8268-e5e737aceac3

		measure 'Score Basis' =
				
				VAR Covered =
				    IF (
				        NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Reliability] ),
				        "Reliability " & FORMAT ( [Weight - Reliability] / [Effective Weight Total], "0%" ) & "; ",
				        ""
				    )
				        & IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Loss Risk] ), "Loss risk " & FORMAT ( [Weight - Loss Risk] / [Effective Weight Total], "0%" ) & "; ", "" )
				        & IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Exception Risk] ), "Exceptions " & FORMAT ( [Weight - Exception Risk] / [Effective Weight Total], "0%" ) & "; ", "" )
				        & IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Score - Cost] ), "Cost " & FORMAT ( [Weight - Cost] / [Effective Weight Total], "0%" ), "" )
				VAR Missing =
				    IF ( ISBLANK ( [Score - Loss Risk] ) || ISBLANK ( [Score - Exception Risk] ),
				        " | Claims components unavailable at service grain - weights reallocated.", "" )
				RETURN
				    "Effective weights: " & Covered & Missing
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\3. Weighted blend with reallocation
			lineageTag: e9336c2e-5203-5bfb-9030-0e1c45b5468f

		measure 'Service Rank' =
				
				IF (
				    [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1,
				    RANKX (
				        FILTER (
				            CALCULATETABLE (
				                VALUES ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
				                REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service )
				            ),
				            [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
				        ),
				        [Service Consistency Score],
				        ,
				        DESC,
				        DENSE
				    )
				)
			formatString: #,0
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\4. Recommendation categories
			lineageTag: 79da7f14-22f5-582a-8238-33a4501e7715

		measure 'Recommendation Category' =
				
				VAR Qualified = [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
				VAR QualCount = [Qualified Service Count]
				VAR Tier = SELECTEDVALUE ( Dim_Service[ServiceTier] )
				VAR Rank = [Service Rank]
				VAR BestPremiumRank =
				    RANKX (
				        FILTER (
				            CALCULATETABLE (
				                VALUES ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
				                REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service )
				            ),
				            [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
				                && SELECTEDVALUE ( Dim_Service[ServiceTier] ) = "Premium"
				        ),
				        [OTD Wilson Lower Bound],
				        ,
				        DESC,
				        DENSE
				    )
				VAR IsVolumeAnchor = [Service Volume Share] >= 0.50
				VAR Volatile = [OTD Volatility (pp)] > 1.5
				VAR BelowFirmOTD = [On-Time Delivery %] < CALCULATE ( [On-Time Delivery %], REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service ) )
				RETURN
				    SWITCH (
				        TRUE (),
				        NOT Qualified, "Not ranked - " & [Qualification Status],
				        QualCount <= 1, "Single qualified service - no comparison possible",
				        // The service the firm actually runs on. It is the default by
				        // economics; the question the dashboard answers is whether its
				        // reliability is acceptable, not whether to replace it.
				        IsVolumeAnchor && BelowFirmOTD, "Volume anchor - reliability below firm average, monitor",
				        IsVolumeAnchor, "Recommended default service",
				        Rank = 1 && Tier <> "Premium", "Recommended default service",
				        Rank = 1, "Best overall performer",
				        BestPremiumRank = 1, "Recommended premium service",
				        Volatile, "Service to monitor - inconsistent month to month",
				        "Qualified alternative"
				    )
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\4. Recommendation categories
			lineageTag: 3881f2c7-7537-5fe4-802a-08f55a4c27af

		measure 'Recommendation Callout' =
				
				VAR MonthsCovered = [Months with Transit Data]
				VAR BestService =
				    CONCATENATEX (
				        TOPN (
				            1,
				            FILTER (
				                CALCULATETABLE (
				                    VALUES ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
				                    REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service )
				                ),
				                [Annual Qualification Flag] = 1
				            ),
				            [Service Consistency Score],
				            DESC
				        ),
				        Dim_Service[ServiceGroup]
				    )
				VAR FirmOTD = CALCULATE ( [On-Time Delivery %], REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service ) )
				RETURN
				    SWITCH (
				        TRUE (),
				        MonthsCovered = 0,
				            "No Time-in-Transit data loaded. Reliability cannot be assessed and no service recommendation can be made.",
				        MonthsCovered < 6,
				            "PROVISIONAL - based on " & MonthsCovered & " month(s) of Time-in-Transit data. "
				                & "Highest-scoring qualified service: " & BestService & ". "
				                & "Firm-wide on-time delivery " & FORMAT ( FirmOTD, "0.0%" ) & ". "
				                & "Do not issue as an annual service policy until at least six completed months are loaded.",
				        "Highest-scoring qualified service: " & BestService & ". Firm-wide on-time delivery "
				            & FORMAT ( FirmOTD, "0.0%" ) & " across " & MonthsCovered & " months."
				    )
			displayFolder: 4 Scoring and Recommendation\4. Recommendation categories
			lineageTag: fec5dd20-7de7-5040-8762-2a3ee5e1d4af

		measure 'Data Basis Banner' =

				        TRUE (),
				        TransitMonths = 0, "NO RELIABILITY DATA",
				        TransitMonths < 6 || ClaimsMonths < 6, "PROVISIONAL",
				        VolMonths < 12, "PARTIAL YEAR",
				        "ANNUAL"
				    )
				RETURN
				    Severity & " - " & [Coverage Summary]
				        & IF ( LEN ( Missing ) > 0, "  |  Not yet loaded: " & Missing, "" )
				        & IF ( Recon <> "Reconciled" && LEFT ( Recon, 2 ) = "VA", "  |  " & Recon, "" )
			displayFolder: 5 Data Quality and Narrative\Banner narrative
			lineageTag: d46e7952-f09f-5377-85e0-b17d9f010de0

		measure 'Data Basis Banner Colour' =
				
				SWITCH (
				    TRUE (),
				    [Transit Months Covered] = 0, "#B3261E",
				    [Transit Months Covered] < 6 || [Claims Months Covered] < 6, "#B26B00",
				    [Volume Months Covered] < 12, "#5B4B8A",
				    "#1F6F54"
				)
			displayFolder: 5 Data Quality and Narrative\Dynamic titles
			lineageTag: d4896e9e-556c-521d-b694-7ab6d44b6ad2

		measure 'Title - Executive Overview' =
				
				VAR Period =
				    IF (
				        ISFILTERED ( Dim_Date[MonthYearLabel] ) || ISFILTERED ( Dim_Date[Quarter] ),
				        CONCATENATEX (
				            VALUES ( Dim_Date[MonthYearLabel] ),
				            Dim_Date[MonthYearLabel], ", ", Dim_Date[SortOrder], ASC
				        ),
				        SELECTEDVALUE ( Dim_Date[Year], "2025" ) & " full year"
				    )
				VAR Scope =
				    IF (
				        ISFILTERED ( Dim_Service[Scope] ),
				        SELECTEDVALUE ( Dim_Service[Scope], "All scopes" ),
				        "Domestic and international"
				    )
				RETURN
				    "UPS Shipping Performance - " & Period & " - " & Scope
			displayFolder: 5 Data Quality and Narrative\Dynamic titles
			lineageTag: d15d733d-06b8-5bd3-8af4-3eb5f161fb55

		measure 'Title - Service Scorecard' =
				
				"Service scorecard - " & [Qualified Service Count] & " of "
				    & CALCULATE (
				        DISTINCTCOUNT ( Dim_Service[ServiceGroup] ),
				        REMOVEFILTERS ( Dim_Service ),
				        Dim_Service[IncludeInRanking] = "Yes"
				    )
				    & " services qualify at "
				    & FORMAT ( [Minimum Shipment Threshold], "#,0" ) & " shipments / "
				    & FORMAT ( [Minimum Volume Share], "0.0%" ) & " share"
			displayFolder: 5 Data Quality and Narrative\Dynamic titles
			lineageTag: 5a00b173-86b2-59f9-b71f-aaedcd0de940

		measure 'Title - Claims' =
				
				"Claims and loss risk - account level only ("
				    & [Claims Months Covered] & " month(s) loaded). "
				    & "Claims carry no service key."
			displayFolder: 5 Data Quality and Narrative\Dynamic titles
			lineageTag: c2abcf63-def0-50a8-ba6a-f6be55e6cb92

		column _
			dataType: int64
			isHidden
			lineageTag: 0fc0f418-2d98-55fe-b0a6-39af2a8c9e05
			summarizeBy: none
			sourceColumn: _

			annotation SummarizationSetBy = Automatic

		partition _Measures = m
			mode: import
			source =
					let
					    Source = #table(type table [_ = Int64.Type], {{0}})
					in
					    Source

		annotation PBI_Id = b4e716f67b215913a3b8220e14dde68e
